title: 数字农业中的闭环LLM副驾驶
summary: 该研究将LLM从数据分析升级为自主AI引导实验，通过49通道植物传感器网络和闭环控制，优化微气候、执行表型协议。在垂直农场验证中，最小时间模式缩短生产周期35%，能量优化模式节省18%能耗，并自主发现暗诱导叶绿素积累策略，节能67.9%。
summary_en: This study evolves LLMs from data analysis to autonomous AI-guided experimentation in digital agriculture, using a 49-channel phytosensor network and closed-loop control. Validated in vertical farms, it reduced production cycle by 35% in minimal-time mode, saved 18% energy in optimization mode, and autonomously discovered dark-induced chlorophyll accumulation saving 67.9% energy.
